## Projects

- [EcoStep](https://devpost.com/software/ecostep-to16qv): Reads appliance labels and utility bills to find home energy rebates worth claiming. Built at BloomKnights 2026 on Next.js, Supabase, and the Gemini API. Source at https://github.com/shadyyr/ecostep
- [Bolo](https://bolo-chi.vercel.app): Turns native-language text, speech, or an email screenshot into a drafted English email without flattening the English already in it. Next.js, Tesseract.js, Gemini and OpenAI APIs. Source at https://github.com/shadyyr/bolo
- [Cooked!](https://devpost.com/software/cooked-m9206r): Ranks recipes by how much of each one you can already make from what is in your fridge. Flask and Gemini backend, Next.js frontend. Built at HackUSF 2026. Source at https://github.com/shadyyr/cooked
- [annabelle.sfx](https://github.com/shadyyr/sfx_soundboard): A sixteen-key soundboard PWA built as a birthday present. Vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, no build step, works offline.
- [Network Connectivity Analyzer](https://github.com/shadyyr/cs2/tree/main/pa3): Tracks how connected a graph stays as edges are removed, in O(log n) average time, using Union-Find and reverse deletion. Java.
- Gaming CPU Project: A team-built RISC-V CPU system-on-chip that runs video games on an FPGA, through IEEE at UCF. Verilog, 5-stage pipeline. Ran Sep to Dec 2025. No public repository.
- Card Game Simulator: A card game simulator in C built on hand-rolled linked lists. Coursework. No public repository.
